text: Good morning ladies and gentlemen from the flight deck. Welcome aboard Transworld Airlines flight 455 to St. Louis. We have levelled off and are cruising at 35,000 feet. We are turning off the fastened seat belt sign now but for your safety please keep your seat belt fastened when in your seats. Which of the following is flight 455 now doing?
